metadata.venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey

ai_summary.key_headline: Clash of Styles: Argentina's Messi vs. Spain's Collective
tactical_insights: Lionel Messi's individual brilliance will test Spain's tournament-best defense, especially against young Lamine Yamal.
Argentina aims for consecutive World Cup titles, a feat not achieved since 1962, under Scaloni's stable leadership.
De la Fuente's possession-based system and counter-pressing will clash with Scaloni's Messi-centric attacking transitions.
